networks.name: stay_steward
networks.description: Book a stay through its own agent, after FactGate checks it.
sample_queries: Book my trip at the stay I picked.
Is Glossy Stay safe to book through its assistant?
Which stays can you book for me?
Pay the deposit for me now.

peer_policy.note: Stay Steward calls three partner networks by full URL after the visitor agrees on a card: FactGate, Verified Stay and Glossy Stay. It loads a stay only after FactGate checked it in this visit and the verdict passes its gate policy: ALLOW, or a CAUTION only for an unmeasured identity; never BLOCK (js/factgate-gate.mjs). Partners get only the target_url private-context field.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
